description: This file defines the API for managing a set of object IDs (oidset) using a hash-based data structure in C. It includes function prototypes for initializing, inserting, removing, checking, and iterating over object IDs, as well as parsing object IDs from files.

classes.name: struct oidset
classes.description: A structure representing a set of object IDs, internally using a hash table.

classes.name: struct oidset_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing the oidset.

methods.name: oidset_init
methods.description: Initialize an oidset with optional preallocation of capacity.

methods.name: oidset_contains
methods.description: Check if an oidset contains a specific object ID.

methods.name: oidset_insert
methods.description: Insert an object ID into the set, making a copy.

methods.name: oidset_insert_from_set
methods.description: Insert all object IDs from one set into another.

methods.name: oidset_remove
methods.description: Remove an object ID from the set.

methods.name: int oidset_size(const struct oidset * set)
methods.description: Return the number of object IDs in the set.

methods.name: oidset_clear
methods.description: Clear all entries from the set, freeing resources.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file
methods.description: Add object IDs from a file into the set, ignoring comments and whitespace.

methods.name: oidset_parse_file_carefully
methods.description: Add object IDs from a file with a callback for custom processing or filtering.

methods.name: void oidset_iter_init(const struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initialize an iterator for the set.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_next(struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Get the next object ID in the iteration.

methods.name: struct:object_id * oidset_iter_first(struct oidset * set,struct oidset_iter * iter)
methods.description: Get the first object ID in the set and initialize iteration.
